name: MessySurfaces
description: MessySurfaces is a dataset containing images of 70 real-world surfaces that need to be cleaned, designed to evaluate grounded commonsense reasoning in robots by leveraging vision and language models for active perception.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for grounded commonsense reasoning in robotics, with growing interest in vision-language active perception settings.
notes: Dataset focuses on real-world surfaces for cleaning tasks to evaluate active perception and grounded commonsense reasoning in robots.
